en: The Triplet of the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Triplet of Seeing as Cause (Dassanahetuttika).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and whose root is to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and whose root is to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance...

A state rooted in what is to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root [condition], there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, there are three.

Dependent on a state that is visible, impinging, and neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation, a state that is visible, impinging, and neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation arises.
By way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root there are twenty-one; under object three ... pe ... under non-disappearance twenty-one.
